profile_text.body:
Microsoft is a public company founded in 1975 and headquartered in Redmond, WA, USA, trading as MSFT with CIK 0000789019. Its most recent 10-K, covering the period ending 2026-06-30, reported revenue of $331,839,000,000. The company page harvested here covers Power Automate, which Microsoft describes as a way to automate workflows and business processes across apps, systems, and websites using AI, digital, and robotic process automation, and as able to automate across nearly unlimited systems, desktop apps, and websites. Customer quotes on that page describe using generative AI and Power Automate to validate and standardize data, with one saying a process that once took over 100 people can be managed by a few.

Its AI products span several areas. Microsoft Copilot is embedded across M365. Azure OpenAI Service offers OpenAI models in Azure regions with enterprise content filtering, Entra ID integration, and data residency controls, while Azure Machine Learning is an MLOps platform with AutoML, a model registry, and responsible AI toolkit integration. Power Automate AI adds Copilot integration, M365 data access, and DLP integration. Other products include Microsoft Teams AI for meeting recaps, SharePoint AI for enterprise content, Microsoft Clipchamp AI for video editing, and Microsoft Designer for image and design generation. On the developer side, AutoGen is a multi-agent conversation framework from Microsoft Research, Semantic Kernel is a model-agnostic orchestration SDK for .NET, Python, and Java that the material says was superseded by Microsoft Agent Framework in 2026, and Microsoft Agent Framework is described as the successor to Semantic Kernel and AutoGen, a unified .NET and Python agent SDK with graph workflows and native MCP and A2A support.

Two lawsuits are listed in the U.S. District Court, S.D. New York: The New York Times Co. v. Microsoft Corp. and OpenAI, and Authors Guild v. OpenAI, Inc. Litigation exposure is also listed for Washington, with a count of 114.
